payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results obtained by the Jasper model on various datasets, including LibriSpeech and Wall Street Journal.

claims.text: The Jasper model achieved state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech test-clean with a WER of 2.95%.
Competitive results were reported on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset, although specific WER values are not provided.
The model also showed good performance on the Hub5'00 conversational evaluation dataset, particularly for the Switchboard subset.
